Real-time sync for your design canvases — on your own box.

Studio Hub is the sync server behind Maude's infinite canvas. Run it on Docker, Fly, or a Raspberry Pi and your team — plus the AI agent — edit the same canvases live. No SaaS, no seat pricing, no data leaving your infra.

$ maude hub deploy fly
token auth rotate kill-switch ~$0.45/mo on fly

One-time invite tokens

Mint a labelled token, paste the ready-made maude design link command into a teammate's terminal. Shown once, hashed at rest.

Rotation is the kill switch

No passwords to leak. Rotate a token and every live session using it is kicked within 5 seconds — the only revoke you need.

Presence — humans + agent

See who's on which canvas in real time, including the AI agent's own cursor. CRDT convergence means no merge conflicts, ever.

Deploy anywhere Docker Compose Fly.io Tailscale Funnel VPS + Caddy
